description: Committee recommends $2.0 million for Willows sanitary trunk upgrade, enabling Willows development.
Funding comes from Trunk Sewer and Wastewater Treatment reserves.
A 15% contingency is requested due to project complexity.

chips.text: Mayor Block questioned why the pipe issue was not found earlier.
Stonebridge neighborhood residents will see relieved capacity constraints.
An exemption to policy C03-036 is requested for a 15% contingency.

description: City prioritizes 22nd Street, 8th Street, Woodlawn for corridor plans.
Evaluation criteria included market demand, connectivity, and equity.
Corridor plans aim to accommodate 15% of Saskatoon's growth.

chips.text: Councillor Parker questioned Preston's lower ranking despite high market demand.
Developers and 340 public respondents provided input on plan area importance.
Mayor Block's question about College Drive public realm funding was deferred to another team.
Equity lens added to evaluation, using census data for housing and deprivation needs.

description: Refer Marr Residence Board's Terms of Reference to administration.
Forward Marr Residence Board's meeting procedures to Council.
Informs Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee about Heritage Society anniversary.

chips.text: Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee receives information about the anniversary.

description: Council received an update on 2025 municipal heritage activities.
Development Appeals Board heard 50% more appeals in 2025.
Appeal fee increased from $52 to $300 this year.

chips.text: Mayor Block asked about the significant increase in development appeals.
Homeowners seeking larger detached garages and downtown property owners were affected.

description: The Saskatoon North Partnership For Growth submitted its 2025 annual report.
